shortDescription: Manages BGP Address-family configuration on HUAWEI CloudEngine switches.

options.name: active_route_advertise
options.description: If the value is true, BGP is enabled to advertise only optimal routes in the RM to peers. If the value is false, BGP is not enabled to advertise only optimal routes in the RM to peers.

options.name: add_path_sel_num
options.description: Number of Add-Path routes. The value is an integer ranging from 2 to 64.

options.name: af_type
options.description: Address family type of a BGP instance.

options.name: allow_invalid_as
options.description: Allow routes with BGP origin AS validation result Invalid to be selected. If the value is true, invalid routes can participate in route selection. If the value is false, invalid routes cannot participate in route selection.

options.name: always_compare_med
options.description: If the value is true, the MEDs of routes learned from peers in different autonomous systems are compared when BGP selects an optimal route. If the value is false, the MEDs of routes learned from peers in different autonomous systems are not compared when BGP selects an optimal route.

options.name: as_path_neglect
options.description: If the value is true, the AS path attribute is ignored when BGP selects an optimal route. If the value is false, the AS path attribute is not ignored when BGP selects an optimal route. An AS path with a smaller length has a higher priority.

options.name: auto_frr_enable
options.description: If the value is true, BGP auto FRR is enabled. If the value is false, BGP auto FRR is disabled.

options.name: default_local_pref
options.description: Set the Local-Preference attribute. The value is an integer. The value is an integer ranging from 0 to 4294967295.

options.name: default_med
options.description: Specify the Multi-Exit-Discriminator (MED) of BGP routes. The value is an integer ranging from 0 to 4294967295.

options.name: default_rt_import_enable
options.description: If the value is true, importing default routes to the BGP routing table is allowed. If the value is false, importing default routes to the BGP routing table is not allowed.

options.name: determin_med
options.description: If the value is true, BGP deterministic-MED is enabled. If the value is false, BGP deterministic-MED is disabled.

options.name: ebgp_ecmp_nexthop_changed
options.description: If the value is true, the next hop of an advertised route is changed to the advertiser itself in EBGP load-balancing scenarios. If the value is false, the next hop of an advertised route is not changed to the advertiser itself in EBGP load-balancing scenarios.

options.name: ebgp_if_sensitive
options.description: If the value is true, after the fast EBGP interface awareness function is enabled, EBGP sessions on an interface are deleted immediately when the interface goes Down. If the value is false, after the fast EBGP interface awareness function is enabled, EBGP sessions on an interface are not deleted immediately when the interface goes Down.

options.name: ecmp_nexthop_changed
options.description: If the value is true, the next hop of an advertised route is changed to the advertiser itself in BGP load-balancing scenarios. If the value is false, the next hop of an advertised route is not changed to the advertiser itself in BGP load-balancing scenarios.

options.name: ibgp_ecmp_nexthop_changed
options.description: If the value is true, the next hop of an advertised route is changed to the advertiser itself in IBGP load-balancing scenarios. If the value is false, the next hop of an advertised route is not changed to the advertiser itself in IBGP load-balancing scenarios.

options.name: igp_metric_ignore
options.description: If the value is true, the metrics of next-hop IGP routes are not compared when BGP selects an optimal route. If the value is false, the metrics of next-hop IGP routes are not compared when BGP selects an optimal route. A route with a smaller metric has a higher priority.

options.name: import_process_id
options.description: Process ID of an imported routing protocol. The value is an integer ranging from 0 to 4294967295.

options.name: import_protocol
options.description: Routing protocol from which routes can be imported.

options.name: ingress_lsp_policy_name
options.description: Ingress lsp policy name.

options.name: load_balancing_as_path_ignore
options.description: Load balancing as path ignore.

options.name: lowest_priority
options.description: If the value is true, enable reduce priority to advertise route. If the value is false, disable reduce priority to advertise route.

options.name: mask_len
options.description: Specify the mask length of an IP address. The value is an integer ranging from 0 to 128.

options.name: max_load_ebgp_num
options.description: Specify the maximum number of equal-cost EBGP routes. The value is an integer ranging from 1 to 65535.

options.name: max_load_ibgp_num
options.description: Specify the maximum number of equal-cost IBGP routes. The value is an integer ranging from 1 to 65535.

options.name: maximum_load_balance
options.description: Specify the maximum number of equal-cost routes in the BGP routing table. The value is an integer ranging from 1 to 65535.

options.name: med_none_as_maximum
options.description: If the value is true, when BGP selects an optimal route, the system uses 4294967295 as the MED value of a route if the route's attribute does not carry a MED value. If the value is false, the system uses 0 as the MED value of a route if the route's attribute does not carry a MED value.

options.name: network_address
options.description: Specify the IP address advertised by BGP. The value is a string of 0 to 255 characters.

options.name: next_hop_sel_depend_type
options.description: Next hop select depend type.

options.name: nexthop_third_party
options.description: If the value is true, the third-party next hop function is enabled. If the value is false, the third-party next hop function is disabled.

options.name: nhp_relay_route_policy_name
options.description: Specify the name of a route-policy for route iteration. The value is a string of 1 to 40 characters.

options.name: originator_prior
options.description: Originator prior.

options.name: policy_ext_comm_enable
options.description: If the value is true, modifying extended community attributes is allowed. If the value is false, modifying extended community attributes is not allowed.

options.name: policy_vpn_target
options.description: If the value is true, VPN-Target filtering function is performed for received VPN routes. If the value is false, VPN-Target filtering function is not performed for received VPN routes.

options.name: preference_external
options.description: Set the protocol priority of EBGP routes. The value is an integer ranging from 1 to 255.

options.name: preference_internal
options.description: Set the protocol priority of IBGP routes. The value is an integer ranging from 1 to 255.

options.name: preference_local
options.description: Set the protocol priority of a local BGP route. The value is an integer ranging from 1 to 255.

options.name: prefrence_policy_name
options.description: Set a routing policy to filter routes so that a configured priority is applied to the routes that match the specified policy. The value is a string of 1 to 40 characters.

options.name: reflect_between_client
options.description: If the value is true, route reflection is enabled between clients. If the value is false, route reflection is disabled between clients.

options.name: reflect_chg_path
options.description: If the value is true, the route reflector is enabled to modify route path attributes based on an export policy. If the value is false, the route reflector is disabled from modifying route path attributes based on an export policy.

options.name: reflector_cluster_id
options.description: Set a cluster ID. Configuring multiple RRs in a cluster can enhance the stability of the network. The value is an integer ranging from 1 to 4294967295.

options.name: reflector_cluster_ipv4
options.description: Set a cluster ipv4 address. The value is expressed in the format of an IPv4 address.

options.name: relay_delay_enable
options.description: If the value is true, relay delay enable. If the value is false, relay delay disable.

options.name: rib_only_enable
options.description: If the value is true, BGP routes cannot be advertised to the IP routing table. If the value is false, Routes preferred by BGP are advertised to the IP routing table.

options.name: rib_only_policy_name
options.description: Specify the name of a routing policy. The value is a string of 1 to 40 characters.

options.name: route_sel_delay
options.description: Route selection delay. The value is an integer ranging from 0 to 3600.

options.name: router_id
options.description: ID of a router that is in IPv4 address format. The value is a string of 0 to 255 characters. The value is in dotted decimal notation.

options.name: router_id_neglect
options.description: If the value is true, the router ID attribute is ignored when BGP selects the optimal route. If the value is false, the router ID attribute is not ignored when BGP selects the optimal route.

options.name: rr_filter_number
options.description: Set the number of the extended community filter supported by an RR group. The value is a string of 1 to 51 characters.

options.name: state
options.description: Specify desired state of the resource.

options.name: summary_automatic
options.description: If the value is true, automatic aggregation is enabled for locally imported routes. If the value is false, automatic aggregation is disabled for locally imported routes.

options.name: supernet_label_adv
options.description: If the value is true, the function to advertise supernetwork label is enabled. If the value is false, the function to advertise supernetwork label is disabled.

options.name: supernet_uni_adv
options.description: If the value is true, the function to advertise supernetwork unicast routes is enabled. If the value is false, the function to advertise supernetwork unicast routes is disabled.

options.name: vrf_name
options.description: Name of a BGP instance. The name is a case-sensitive string of characters. The BGP instance can be used only after the corresponding VPN instance is created. The value is a string of 1 to 31 case-sensitive characters.

options.name: vrf_rid_auto_sel
options.description: If the value is true, VPN BGP instances are enabled to automatically select router IDs. If the value is false, VPN BGP instances are disabled from automatically selecting router IDs.
